backlog.verification: Compare generated packet against statute and official source; verify no NFP forms appear in CBCA track.

backlog.item: Resolve exact current federal paper incorporation route
backlog.reason: Current service/index list online; older generic/Form 2 material mentions mail/email.
backlog.dependency: Registry-published clarification or authorized inquiry (not performed in research)
backlog.acceptance: Either a current complete channel/form/ISC/signature/fee/time/destination entry or an explicit unresolved assistance branch
backlog.verification: Obtain current registry evidence; do not copy generic $250 assumptions or treat Form 2 as complete package.

backlog.item: Track certificate, registry access custodian, post-incorporation records and BN/RC separately
backlog.reason: Portal submission, corporate formation, share issuance and authorized account access are distinct states.
backlog.dependency: Document evidence and legal-action approval workflow
backlog.acceptance: Workspace pending until certificate evidence; paid share-issue and organizational decisions retained; no raw key/password solicitation
backlog.verification: Review evidence-driven transitions and confirm only appropriate roles can view access-custody metadata.

backlog.item: Keep existing Ontario entry but make full legal automation conditional on completed current-law review
backlog.reason: Official notices verify workflows, but direct e-Laws/fee pages were inaccessible and current OBCA differs from CBCA.
backlog.dependency: Accessible current OBCA consolidation; legal reviewer; registry fee refresh
backlog.acceptance: Verified initial-return home/EP distinction now; complete governance/status badge only after ss. 93-104, 118, 126, 129, 140.2, 154 and related provisions reviewed
backlog.verification: Review statutory defaults, majority written ordinary route and non-signer notice, residency repeal, internal ISC scope, and annual-return applicability.

backlog.item: Separate workspace accounts from legal people/capacities
backlog.reason: Owner/Admin/Director/Member labels do not establish statutory directorship, membership, shareholding, signing authority or inspection entitlement.
backlog.dependency: Legal rules comparison and identity reconciliation.
backlog.acceptance: Persist person identity, capacity, organization, effective dates, share/member class, voting rights, appointment/cessation evidence and authorized filer/signatory status separately from app membership. Statutory member-register export excludes CRM notes and unrelated confidential fields; inspection request workflow records claimant capacity, purpose/restriction review and disclosed extract.
backlog.verification: Director legal capacity with non-Director app role; former member/director historical rights; shareholder without workspace account; disabled app account requiring lawful alternate inspection fulfillment; same-name people remain distinct.

backlog.item: Persist obligations by cycle and completion evidence
backlog.reason: Current recurring helper skips old due dates to compute next occurrence.
backlog.dependency: Dated rule ID/version and filing/evidence ledger.
backlog.acceptance: A missed annual cycle remains overdue until recorded completion/waiver/applicable exception; next cycle can exist simultaneously; rule changes do not overwrite history; different home/extra registrations stay separate.
backlog.verification: Clock passes deadline with no filing; late filing after next cycle opens; revised legal due rule; deregistration; leap-day anniversaries; months versus days offsets.

backlog.item: Use the correct electorate and exact threshold
backlog.reason: Custom eligible-member/quorum denominators are currently approximated as votes cast.
backlog.dependency: Legal capacity and share/member class data; entity-specific rules.
backlog.acceptance: Vote result stores denominator source/date, counted votes, abstentions/exclusions, class rights and threshold; insufficient denominator produces not-evaluable; calculations distinguish strict majority from at-least supermajority and written consent eligibility.
backlog.verification: Exact two-thirds, tie ordinary vote, missing eligible count, class vote, proxy validity, quorum changes, written resolution with excluded director conflict.

backlog.item: Replace label matches with explicit memberships
backlog.reason: Mutable or duplicate names can confer committee document access.
backlog.dependency: Person/identity mappings and reviewed migration queue.
backlog.acceptance: Runtime access uses explicit stable IDs and valid appointment dates; ambiguous email/name matches are review suggestions only; revocation invalidates future content issuance.
backlog.verification: Duplicate names, renamed profiles, recycled email, member-to-director transition, expired committee appointment and unrelated committee.

backlog.item: Attach official/template provenance and entity guards
backlog.reason: Packet catalog selection is not a legal compatibility check and drafts are not official forms.
backlog.dependency: Official template inventory and legal document review.
backlog.acceptance: Each generated document records template ID/version/source/reuse conditions, applicable statute/subtype, legal review state and adoption/signature evidence. Incompatible generation paths reject even with a manually chosen packet key.
backlog.verification: Society requests corporation packet; corporation requests society packet; invalid subtype; draft versus adopted copy; updated official form supersedes old template without erasing historical files.

backlog.item: Implement one authoritative provider per document and proof of concept
backlog.reason: SharePoint/R2 are design proposals, not existing adapters.
backlog.dependency: Owner-approved tenant/library details, least-privilege Graph consent or R2 bucket configuration, P0 document/upload fixes.
backlog.acceptance: Workspace maps to approved provider/library; app document UUID survives rename/move; provider object/version IDs and eTags stored; upload/download/version/export work; another workspace is denied; revocation and legal-hold behavior documented.
backlog.verification: Small approved test library/bucket only; guest and app-only scenarios; throttling retry; cross-workspace denial; interrupted migration; complete metadata+content export; provider URLs not logged.

backlog.item: Preserve existing review gates and add legal-force semantics
backlog.reason: Schema validates reviewers/approvers but does not distinguish mandatory law from optional operational reminders or per-provision effective dates.
backlog.dependency: Current primary sources, reviewer process and exact rule trigger facts.
backlog.acceptance: Required/conditional/recommended/operational classes are explicit; each executable rule has applicable entity/context, trigger, calculation, exceptions, provision, evidence and effective window; invalid review transitions fail validation; pending incorporation is separate from active legal entity obligations.
backlog.verification: Operational task cannot display as mandatory filing; source effective date differs from retrieval; superseded provision; conditional exemption; missing essential fact remains unresolved.

backlog.item: Separate people, workspace roles and legal capacities
backlog.reason: App roles do not establish statutory member, director, shareholder, beneficial-owner or signatory status.
backlog.dependency: Organization and identity model
backlog.acceptance: Each legal capacity has evidence and effective dates; removing access does not change historical legal registers.
backlog.verification: Disable a workspace user while retaining their historical directorship and shares; test a legal records request by a non-login person.

backlog.item: Classify templates and verify reuse terms
backlog.reason: A statutory model, government sample, fillable PDF, preparation worksheet and executed document have different authority and rights.
backlog.dependency: Template inventory and legal review
backlog.acceptance: Each template records source/version/reuse conditions, required customization and filing versus retention; statutory-text attribution implemented where applicable.
backlog.verification: Check an embedded statutory model, externally linked PDF, customized draft, executed original and certified registry output.

backlog.item: Separate BN and tax programs from charity status
backlog.reason: Business incorporation may assign BN/RC automatically while other programs and charity status need separate decisions.
backlog.dependency: Official incorporation output capture
backlog.acceptance: Receipt evidence and each program identifier/status are independent; no duplicate BN created by preparation flow.
backlog.verification: BC company, federal corporation and BC society cases with different payroll/GST/charity facts.

backlog.item: Implement bounded uploads, stable locators, conflicts and change reconciliation
backlog.reason: Native file changes and temporary URLs otherwise break document identity and history.
backlog.dependency: P0 authorization, locator/finalization and approved resource
backlog.acceptance: Small/resumable upload, version download, rename, conflict, retry, external change, delta reset and subscription renewal supported.
backlog.verification: STO-POC-04/05/08 with synthetic fixtures; test selected scope for each production endpoint.

backlog.item: Implement immutable version keys and feature-specific controls
backlog.reason: R2 does not expose the assumed S3 historical-version/Object Lock/replication API surface.
backlog.dependency: P0 abstraction and measured current RustFS usage
backlog.acceptance: Core S3 functions work; unsupported features are rejected or replaced explicitly; scoped runtime credentials cannot change lock policy.
backlog.verification: STO-POC-12, overwrite/delete lock tests, restore from own version keys and an independent backup.

backlog.item: Make a document download broker and tested offboarding runbook
backlog.reason: Provider URLs, direct SharePoint links and eventually propagated grants have distinct revocation lifetimes.
backlog.dependency: Chosen access model and native sharing policy
backlog.acceptance: New broker requests deny after removal; held content stays retained; remaining native grants and issued URLs are reported accurately.
backlog.verification: STO-POC-09 with existing URL, new URL, direct Microsoft access and another workspace tested separately.

backlog.item: Add explicit retention, purge, restore and inspectable export states
backlog.reason: Version history and provider durability do not establish legal retention or a complete recoverable record.
backlog.dependency: Entity-specific retention/records decisions; provider administrator policy
backlog.acceptance: Export all required versions and metadata with hash manifest; deletion distinguishes retained/blocked/purged; restore succeeds.
backlog.verification: STO-POC-10/11; statutory inspection scenario and actual file hash verification.

backlog.item: Capture application allow/deny audit and link provider events
backlog.reason: Vendor logs have coverage/retention limits and app-only provider events may identify the app rather than the human.
backlog.dependency: Action policy and privacy/retention decisions
backlog.acceptance: Events identify actor/workspace/document/version/action/outcome without exposing credential URLs; denial and background actions logged.
backlog.verification: Compare known app operations to Microsoft/R2 events; explicitly test denied requests missing from R2 vendor logs.

backlog.item: Separate offline local records from connected hosted identity.
backlog.reason: Local auth-disabled convenience cannot bypass hosted authorization and remote revocation cannot retract already downloaded offline content.
backlog.dependency: Native adapter review, approved offline-data policy, external-browser OAuth support.
backlog.acceptance: Hosted calls require the selected broker; native sign-in uses a vetted external-browser/PKCE flow with bounded callbacks and secure token custody. Offline state is visibly local and does not grant server access.
backlog.verification: Invalid/replayed callback, offline-to-online transition, removed member with cached files, and missing-hosted-config tests.

backlog.item: Review benefit, ULC, public and CCC documents/rules separately before full automation.
backlog.reason: Material liability, duty, reporting, director and securities differences.
backlog.dependency: Qualified subtype legal review and current supported registry transactions.
backlog.acceptance: Each subtype has dedicated evidence/requirements/templates; no ordinary-template claim of suitability.
backlog.verification: Specialist-reviewed sample packets and registry data mappings.

backlog.item: Maintain CRA status/accounts as separate registrations
backlog.reason: Incorporation does not establish charity, tax exemption or every tax account.
backlog.dependency: Accountant/charity-purpose review; actual incorporation output
backlog.acceptance: Charity decision evidence and RR account distinct from BN; tax tasks applicability-based; no automatic duplicate BN request.
backlog.verification: Ordinary society/no charity, registered charity, unincorporated organization and pre-existing BN scenarios.

backlog.item: Defer arbitrary per-person module overrides until base policy works
backlog.reason: Overrides multiply inconsistent authorization states without solving current handler gaps.
backlog.dependency: Explicit matrix, central action guard, stable record ACL and audit trail.
backlog.acceptance: First release supports clear roles and record-specific access; any later override has action-level scope, reason, approver, expiry, deny precedence and effective-access preview; cannot create Owner authority or statutory capacity.
backlog.verification: Role change with expiring override; explicit deny; revoked record grant; feature hidden/unhidden without privilege change.

backlog.item: Add per-workspace usage and retention forecasts
backlog.reason: R2 operation rounding, many versions, SharePoint hold storage and advanced licenses affect cost more than one current file size.
backlog.dependency: Measured usage, contract SKUs/rates and retention settings
backlog.acceptance: Dashboard distinguishes provider byte/version counts, shared allowances, subscription/add-on/backup and monthly usage estimates.
backlog.verification: Reconcile one billing period with provider invoice/usage and verify rounding thresholds.

backlog.item: Extend pilot to per-client tenant onboarding and exports
backlog.reason: Using the operator’s company tenant for unrelated clients creates custody, isolation and licensing questions.
backlog.dependency: Successful single-tenant POC; commercial/legal review
backlog.acceptance: Each client sees only its connection; exports and revocation leave custody with the owning company; consent changes are auditable.
backlog.verification: Two approved tenants with separate application grants and offboarding tests; do not test in unauthorised customer tenants.
